title_en: Doctors and Pharmacies (16/20): A Visit to the Dermatologist
note_en: A verb + 了 + quantity tells you how much of something happened: 胳膊上长了不少红点 "a lot of red spots had come up on his arm" and 去海边玩了一整天 "spent a whole day at the beach." Where English uses "there are" or a separate time phrase, Chinese puts the amount or duration right after the verb with 了.
